body.name: Complete Gaussian-weighted gluing ledger
body.construction: For every \(R_f\ge0\), action functional \(f:\mathcal A\to[0,R_f]\), mean cell \(C\), incidence edge \(e=(i,j)\), protected neighborhood \(P_{C,e}\), and path load \(g_{C,e}(w)=\sum_{k:e\in\pi_C(k)}\lambda_k(w)\), define \(F_i^f(w)=\sum_{A\in\mathcal A}f(A)q_{i,A}(w)\), take \(M_{C,f}=C\cap D_v\) for coverage of \(v\) and \(M_{C,f}=C\cap H_r\) for risk, and set \(\Gamma_{C,e}^f=\sup_{h\in M_{C,f}}[\int_{P_{C,e}}g_{C,e}|F_i^f-F_j^f|\phi_{\Sigma}(w-h)\,dw+R_f\int_{P_{C,e}^{c}}g_{C,e}\phi_{\Sigma}(w-h)\,dw]\). Define \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\) as the sum of all such terms, chart errors, \(R_f\omega(h)/2\), Gaussian tails, covariance enclosures, integration enclosures, and rational rounding errors.
inputs: a finite core and recession library
protected neighborhoods and outward integral enclosures
